Correct jack center/sleeve; W1/3 connected directly to W2/1 with red 18 AWG wire; F2 T1 A fitted in the lighting feed; correct capacitor polarity; verified header orientation; no speaker-to-ground connection; all adapters continuity-tested; no exposed contacts or pinched wires.

Use the specified Mean Well GST40A05-P1J (5 V, 5 A) power supply. The circuit is designed around its output and protection characteristics; do not substitute another supply. Follow the staged guide checks with servo cables disconnected for the initial lighting test. Unplug power before every wiring change; support the mechanism before powered motion.

On actual 3A+, run normal approved motion, 16-light patterns at the initial brightness ceiling, duplex conversation and theme playback together. Record power-jack/Pi/audio-module minimum voltage and peak/steady current. Target ≥4.85 V at Pi under the tested load, never exceed 5.25 V on the 5 V system, and no fresh undervoltage/throttle flags or USB resets. These are prototype acceptance targets, not manufacturer certification thresholds.

Keep sustained normal-operation input at or below a design target of 4 A for the 5 A supply; capture transients separately. If that fails, review the load and wiring design; do not substitute a larger supply. Confirm OEM leads, connector leads, F2 and connectors remain within their ratings and acceptable temperature rise after an hour of the heaviest intended workload.

F2 T1 A provides supplemental interruption for lighting wiring faults; it is not a hard current limit. Fit the specified T1 A time-delay fuse in the lighting supply. Do not bypass it or fit a higher-rated fuse. Supply protection and F2 do not guarantee that every fault clears before wiring or components overheat. A jammed servo can keep pushing and overheat; stop immediately.

Check clean music and speech at the intended listening volume, including bass/percussion, base rattles and hiss. Repeat with the bottom cover fitted; inspect the microphone openings and speaker mounting if performance changes.

At 0.5 and 1 m: quiet/normal speech, room noise, motors active, interruption during playback and false self-responses. No documented hardware AEC is assumed. Do not accept a regression by silently switching to half-duplex.

Implement and verify the 16-address lighting profile, including the mouth zone, before powering the lighting assembly. On the actual 512 MB Pi 3A+, check the client, voice effects and motion together for memory exhaustion, sustained swapping, audio underruns and startup failures. Select USB input/output by stable device identity and verify automatic startup behavior.

Verify the 16-light address sequence, red/green/blue order and visible mouth end pixels, with no flicker during motion/audio. With external power disconnected, remove and refit the plain cover, reach the SD card, and operate each local disconnect without loading a board or pulling a wire. The character remains attached for routine base work.
